draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Muvattupuzha! The name means three rivers, and you can walk to Thriveni, the spot where they meet. Right at that confluence is the ancient Puzhakkarakavu Devi Temple that gave the town its name.
draft.hungryLine: Expect Kerala meals with lots of curries and fish fry, and if you're curious, toddy shops serve all sorts of meat and fish alongside.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Start at the Holy Magi Forane Church, walk to the Puzhakarakavu Devi Temple, then on to Thriveni Sangamam where the rivers join.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take a vallom, a country boat, across the river, or walk the banks where fishermen sell their catch.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Thodupuzha River here rarely runs dry in summer, because water from the Idukki hydro-electric project drains into it.

spots.name: Holy Magi Forane Church
spots.detail: 7 min walk · A grand church by the Thodupuzha river

spots.name: Puzhakarakavu Devi Temple
spots.detail: 10 min walk · The ancient temple at the river confluence

spots.name: Thriveni Sangamam
spots.detail: 12 min walk · Where three rivers become one

legends.title: The cow's footprint spring
legends.body: Water flows out of a hole in the rock shaped like a cow's hoof, and it's considered holy. It fills the temple pond.

legends.title: Kadamattathu Kathanar
legends.body: This church is famous for its links to Aabu father and Kadamattathu Kathanar. It sits in the country around Muvattupuzha.

tips.title: Catch a temple festival.
tips.body: Puzhakkarakavu's 10-day festival ends on 26 December, and Sree Kumara Bhajana Devaswom holds its 8-day festival in February.

tips.title: Leave the meat outside.
tips.body: Non-vegetarian food isn't allowed on the grounds of the Nettorkottu Bhagavathi Temple.

story.title: Temple at the confluence
story.body: The ancient Puzhakkarakavu Devi Temple stands where three rivers meet. That meeting gave the town its name, Muvattupuzha.

story.title: A mosque opens
story.body: Land for the Central Mahallu Juma Masjid was bought in early 1927, and the first Friday prayer was held there on 19 February. It sits beside the Kavumkara market.

story.title: A seat dissolved
story.body: The Muvattupuzha Lok Sabha constituency was dissolved to make way for the new Wayanad constituency.

story.title: A river town
story.body: The census counted 30,397 people in Muvattupuzha, which sits where the MC Road meets National Highway 49.

story.title: Follow the rivers
story.body: Walk to Thriveni, take a vallom across and watch the fishermen. Tell me which river you think is the prettiest.
